description: This file defines the ErrorHandler interface and its implementations for handling errors related to shuffle block transfer in Apache Spark's network shuffle module. It includes logic for retrying and logging errors during push and fetch operations.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling error retry and logging policies in shuffle block transfer operations.

classes.name: ErrorHandler.BlockPushErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles errors specific to pushing shuffle blocks, with logic to determine retry and log behavior based on exception types and error codes.

classes.name: ErrorHandler.BlockFetchErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles errors related to fetching shuffle blocks, with retry and log policies based on error message content.

methods.name: shouldRetryError
methods.description: Determines whether an error should trigger a retry based on the Throwable.

methods.name: shouldLogError
methods.description: Determines whether an error should be logged.
